tips.sm2Title: How Does FSRS Smart Spaced Repetition Work?
tips.sm2Desc: FSRS estimates each question's memory stability (how long it sticks) and difficulty from your recall ratings, scheduling the next review right before you forget — fewer repeats on easy items, timely practice on tough ones.
tips.ratingDesc: Pick by how easily you recalled the answer: Again (forgot or missed — short retry) · Hard (recalled with effort) · Good (recalled smoothly) · Easy (instant and confident).
